description:
The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) Doctoral Fellowship is a significant initiative aimed at promoting research in social sciences across India. 

The scheme was launched in the year 2016. 

It was established to support PhD scholars who are engaged in social science research. 

The primary objective of the ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship is to provide financial assistance to deserving candidates pursuing their doctoral studies. 

The fellowship aims to encourage high-quality research in various fields of social sciences. 

This includes disciplines such as sociology, political science, economics, anthropology, and geography, among others. 

The fellowship provides a monthly stipend of INR 25,000. 

In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship also offers a contingency grant of INR 10,000 per annum. 

This grant can be utilized for research-related expenses such as books, travel, and other necessary materials. 

The fellowship is awarded for a maximum duration of two years. 

Candidates who are awarded the fellowship are expected to complete their doctoral research within this timeframe. 

The eligibility criteria for the ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship are specific and detailed. 

Applicants must hold a Master's degree in social sciences or a related field from a recognized university. 

The minimum percentage required in the Master's degree is 55%. 

Candidates who are currently enrolled in a PhD program are also eligible to apply. 

However, they must have completed their coursework and passed their comprehensive exams. 

The age limit for applicants is set at 40 years. 

This age limit is applicable as of the date of application submission. 

The application process for the ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship is straightforward but requires careful attention to detail. 

Interested candidates must submit their applications online through the official ICSSR website. 

The application form must be filled out completely and accurately. 

Candidates are required to provide details of their educational qualifications and research proposals. 

A research proposal is a critical component of the application. 

It must outline the objectives, methodology, and expected outcomes of the proposed research. 

In addition to the application form, candidates must submit several supporting documents. 

These documents include a copy of their Master's degree certificate. 

Candidates must also provide a detailed curriculum vitae. 

Two letters of recommendation from academic referees are also required. 

The application deadline is typically announced on the ICSSR website. 

Candidates should check the website regularly for updates on deadlines. 

The selection process for the fellowship is competitive. 

Applications are reviewed by a committee of experts in the field of social sciences. 

Shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview. 

The final selection is based on the quality of the research proposal and the candidate's academic credentials. 

The fellowship is administered by the Indian Council of Social Science Research. 

The ICSSR is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. 

It is responsible for promoting research in social sciences and providing financial assistance to researchers. 

The contact details for the ICSSR are available on their official website. 

Candidates can reach out to the ICSSR for any queries related to the fellowship. 

The fellowship is part of a broader effort by the Indian government to enhance research capabilities in social sciences. 

It aims to foster a culture of research and innovation among young scholars. 

The ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship has seen a significant number of applications since its inception. 

In the year 2022, approximately 1,500 applications were received. 

Out of these, around 200 fellowships were awarded. 

This indicates a selection rate of approximately 13%. 

The fellowship has contributed to various research projects that address pressing social issues in India. 

Research funded by this fellowship has covered topics such as poverty alleviation, gender studies, and social justice. 

The ICSSR also encourages interdisciplinary research through this fellowship. 

This allows scholars to collaborate across different fields of study. 

The fellowship is a vital resource for scholars who may face financial constraints. 

It enables them to focus on their research without the burden of financial stress. 

The ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship has gained recognition among academic circles. 

It is considered a prestigious opportunity for emerging researchers in social sciences. 

The fellowship not only supports individual scholars but also contributes to the overall development of social science research in India. 

The ICSSR regularly organizes workshops and seminars for fellowship recipients. 

These events provide networking opportunities and enhance research skills. 

The fellowship has a positive impact on the academic community. 

It encourages young scholars to contribute to policy-making and social development. 

The ICSSR continues to evaluate and improve the fellowship program. 

Feedback from past recipients is taken into account for future enhancements. 

The fellowship is an essential part of India's commitment to advancing knowledge in social sciences. 

It aligns with the government's broader goals of promoting higher education and research excellence. 

The ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship is a significant step towards nurturing the next generation of social scientists in India. 

It provides the necessary support for scholars to conduct impactful research that can benefit society. 

The fellowship is a testament to the importance of social science research in addressing contemporary challenges. 

Overall, the ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship represents a crucial investment in the future of social science research in India. 

It empowers scholars to explore and analyze complex social issues. 

This ultimately contributes to informed decision-making and policy formulation. 

The fellowship is a valuable opportunity for aspiring researchers dedicated to making a difference in society.
